summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a follow-on investment of approximately C$4.8 million from Hartree Partners LP via exercise of a top-up right under an existing investor rights agreement. The company will issue 526,617 common shares at C$9.06 per share, a price determined by the agreement; no premium or board recommendation is disclosed. The financing is subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval and expected to close about April 29, 2026, with a 4-month-and-one-day hold period in Canada. Proceeds will fund project development and general corporate purposes. The filing does not represent a special situation but a routine capital raise under a pre-existing agreement, so the appropriate classification is 'None'.
